value.text: INFERENCE: listed or grown outdoors in a hot-desert source (USDA FAS Cairo, Egypt Citrus Annual EG2025-0031 (17 Dec 2025)); no exposure group given; class from our sun attribute (full sun); no heat tolerance stated in words; class high. Commercial crop evidence (cultivation), not a landscape list; PRDM rates Citrus limonum group D (partial shade in summer), so treat orange similarly when sited.

source.locator: USDA FAS Cairo, Egypt Citrus Annual EG2025-0031 (17 Dec 2025): Production: oranges on reclaimed desert land, north to south
source.quote: Oranges are Egypt's primary citrus crop, accounting for about 80 percent of the total citrus cultivation area and are grown throughout the country from north to south.
